submitted.rationale: Index 9 (Sb 0.349) had the highest measured EQE: 0.1245%. Index 10 (Sb 0.375) was almost the same at 0.1220%, so the peak is broad and lies around Sb 0.35–0.38. EQE fell off sharply toward Sb-poor (0.021% at 0.219) and Sb-rich compositions (0.0086% at 0.661, 0.0046% at 0.819). XRD at Sb 0.29, 0.35 and 0.45 showed the same rutile-like pattern, so the phase doesn't change across this region and XRD can't separate the candidates. The difference comes from composition within that phase.

rejected.reason: This is the nominal NiSb2O6 stoichiometry, but EQE was only 0.0086%.
Not measured for EQE; same XRD phase as index 9, and the GP predicted a lower mean.
